description_en: Disables function invocations. You can also stop all ongoing requests. When a function is disabled, new instances cannot be created and provisioned instances are destroyed. This OpenAPI is in beta
description_zh: 禁止函数被调用，可选终止所有正在处理的请求。函数被禁止调用后，将无法创建新实例，同时预留实例会被销毁。该 OpenAPI 处于内测阶段
kebab_example: aliyun fc disable-function-invocation --reason Service_decommission --abort-ongoing-request false --function-name helloworld --region cn-hangzhou
name: DisableFunctionInvocation

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to immediately stop all ongoing requests
parameters.help_zh: 是否立即终止正在处理的所有请求
parameters.name: abort_ongoing_request

parameters.name: reason

parameters.help_en: The name of the function to disable
parameters.name: function_name
